title: Daily News Brief — Oct 23, 2026: OCC finalizes GENIUS Act rule; JPM Coin comes to Ethereum
summary:
Week in review for October 19–23, 2026, and the first episode with the new digital cash segment. The OCC finalizes its GENIUS Act stablecoin rule with looser liquidity, reserve and yield terms; JPMorgan brings JPM Coin to Ethereum mainnet; the SEC names tokenization in its fiscal 2027 exam priorities; and sixteen issuers object to their stock trading on OKX ICE. Also: the DTC Tokenization Service details, BlackRock's push for tokenized money funds as collateral, ESMA's tokenised collateral call for evidence, HSBC RedCoin, SoFi's tokenized deposit, and BLOOM's expansion.
